notes.title: Difficulty adjustment patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Redeals added to Pyramid and Relaxed Pyramid[/h1]
These games had extremely low win rates (Pyramid had 0 wins in over 4000 games).  Turns out that it's common that redeals are allowed in these variants.  Thus, Pyramid now allows 2 redeals and Relaxed Pyramid allows 1.  I will also be resetting the global stats on these variants so that I can accurately measure the difficulty of them with the redeals.

[h1]Full change list[/h1]

[list]
[*]Agnes Bernauer: Changed difficulty rating from Medium to Hard
[*]All in a Row: Changed difficulty from Very Hard to Hopeless

notes.title: Hotfix for selecting same start & destination states in campaign mode
notes.notes: It was possible for users to select the same state for their start & destination, rendering the campaign unplayable.  This has been fixed

notes.title: Hotfix for unwinnable games
notes.notes:
A few variants were incorrectly registering wins as losses - this has now been fixed

Variants impacted:  All in a Row, Black Hole, Golf

notes.title: Last update before the game is available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Solitaire Expeditions is releasing into Early Access tomorrow, so I just finished wrapping up some things I wanted to get done before release:

[list]
[*]Added two new variants:  La Belle Lucie and Fan (bringing the total to 106)
[*]Added some new card backs and backgrounds 
[*]Updated the campaign UI to include some elements for guiding the user in how to play campaign mode
[*]Added a career stats display
[*]Moved achievements out of the options dialog and into their own dialog
[*]Cards for new decks are now unlocked at a rate of 4 per 1 rewards point (it was taking far too long to unlock a new deck)
[/list]

notes.title: New variant (Will o' the Wisp) plus some other small changes
notes.notes:
Added a new variant, Will o' the Wisp.  This gametype uses the same rules as Spiderette but has a slightly different layout.  Like Spiderette, this game is very difficult to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741714/b1bc69e366a24d8963fbd69c2213d18945026c63.png[/img]

Other changes:

[list]
[*]Added in-game hotkey to toggle automatic autoplay (Shift+A)
[*]Fix bug in circular move detection logic that would sometimes incorrectly declare a loss
[*]Documented hotkeys in button tooltips
[/list]
